definitions.explanation: The most important or essential part of something. The critical element that determines success or failure.
The liver organ, or more broadly the internal organs. Also used figuratively to refer to courage or nerve.

examples.japanese: ⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肝|きも}だ。

examples.english: The key to this dish lies in how you control the heat.

examples.japanese: {肝|きも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{据|す}わって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: To have guts; to be bold.

examples.japanese: {肝|きも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{冷|ひ}やした→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肝|きも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{動|どう}じない→動じる：30764_doujiru⟧。
examples.english: He has nerves of steel, so he stays calm in any situation.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is common in everyday conversation to identify the most important aspect of something. 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肝|きも}だ means "~ is the key."

Sense 2 appears mainly in set expressions involving courage, fear, or surprise.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {肝|きも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{据|す}わる: to have guts, to be unflinching
- ⟦{肝|きも}を{冷|ひ}やす→肝を冷やす：21641_kimowohiyasu⟧: to be frightened, to have a scare
- {肝|きも}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{太|ふと}い→太い：02955_futoi⟧: bold, nervy
- ⟦{肝|きも}{試|だめ}し→肝試し：10621_kimodameshi⟧: test of courage (haunted house, etc.)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{肝心|かんじん}→肝心：21541_kanjin⟧な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧: crucial point (compound using {肝|きも})
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{肝|きも}: ~ is the key
